archives.confirmed: A quaternion-valued free head is used as a 32-byte glass-piece index, producing the exact invalid read.
archives.separate_reproduction: Exact native stock skeleton allocators wrap after 64 maximum-size server allocations and exhaust after 72 client allocations. This is an independent capacity dependency, not a dump-proven first writer of the glass chain.
archives.causal_limit: The first retail write corrupting the glass free chain is not in this dump. Test28 validates current/next links and repairs inactive links from the occupancy map; future dumps include that map and pool metadata.
